name: theonotes
description: Search, read and write your Theo Notes library from Claude Code. Runs the MCP server inside the Theo Notes Mac app; needs the app, opened once.

author.name: True Brew Birdie Ltd. and Theo Notes contributors

only_tags.title: Only tags
only_tags.description: Comma-separated, for example work, home/kids. Claude sees only notes with these tags or their nested tags. Leave empty for the whole library.

exclude_tags.title: Exclude tags
exclude_tags.description: Comma-separated, for example private. Claude never sees notes with these tags or their nested tags.
